about.bio_html:
Security researcher with 15+ years in the field across red and blue teams. I work on malware analysis, reverse engineering, client-side threat detection and WAF engineering. I also report CVEs in widely used software.

I started at Symantec in malware and threat research, then handled SOC work (Tier 1 to 3) as a SOC Analyst at JPMorgan Chase. After that I built WAF detections at Cloudflare, worked on client-side and supply-chain security at c/side, then went back to Cloudflare. These days I focus on security research, CTFs and writing. I compete with Water Paddlers in CTFs and finished 2nd at DEF CON three years running (2023 to 2025).

advisories.title: Heap-Based Buffer Overflow → Local Elevation of Privilege
advisories.desc: A heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Windows Media Foundation can allow an unauthorized local attacker to elevate privileges. Microsoft published the vulnerability on 2026-10-13 with CVSS 3.1 score 7.8 (High). Reported to Microsoft by Himanshu Anand; public MSRC researcher acknowledgement was not yet indexed as of 2026-10-14.

advisories.title: Unbounded Resource Allocation → Remote Denial of Service
advisories.desc: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling in OpenSSH for Windows can allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to deny service over the network. Microsoft published the vulnerability on 2026-10-13 with CVSS 3.1 score 7.5 (High) and CWE-770. Reported to Microsoft by Himanshu Anand; public MSRC researcher acknowledgement was not yet indexed as of 2026-10-14.

advisories.title: Integer Underflow in IPv6 Extension Header Parsing → Out-of-Bounds Read / Denial of Service
advisories.desc: Nmap through version 7.99 failed to properly bound IPv6 extension-header parsing within captured packets. A crafted IPv6 response containing a truncated extension header could cause an integer underflow, out-of-bounds memory reads and a crash during raw IPv6 scans. CVSS 3.1: 6.5 (Medium). CWE-191. Official CVE record credits Himanshu Anand as the vulnerability finder. Published June 28, 2026. The fix was subsequently referenced in an OpenEmbedded/Yocto Project patch submitted October 21, 2026.

advisories.title: Predictable Recovery Codes Could Allow Password Reset
advisories.desc: A flaw in the self-service password recovery mechanism could let an unauthenticated attacker predict recovery codes and reset a user's password. Zimbra credited Himanshu Anand and Hyunwoo Kim for reporting the issue in its Zimbra Collaboration 10.1.21 security advisory published on 2026-09-24.

advisories.title: Out-of-Bounds Read in PICT Image Import
advisories.desc: LibreOffice's PICT image importer contained an out-of-bounds read. The Document Foundation credited Himanshu Anand for reporting the issue. The fix was released in LibreOffice 26.2.5.

advisories.title: Staff Invitation Email Validation Bypass
advisories.desc: Invitation acceptance did not require the accepting email address to match the intended recipient. Possession of a leaked invitation could therefore grant staff access to a different address and undermine email-domain restrictions. Affected ghost versions: >= 0.5.0 and < 6.62.0. Fixed in 6.62.0. CVSS 3.1: 4.3 (Moderate). CWE-807. Published 2026-09-03; CVE-2026-103267 was published on 2026-10-01.

advisories.title: Unauthenticated Checkout → Member Account Changes and Newsletter HTML Injection
advisories.desc: The Stripe checkout flow could associate a subscription with an existing member and modify that member's name without authentication. Unsafe handling of that name in newsletters could also produce HTML injection, with script execution dependent on the mail client. Affected ghost versions: >= 5.2.0 and < 6.62.0. Fixed in 6.62.0. CVSS 3.1: 7.1 (High). CWE-79 and CWE-863. Published 2026-09-03; CVE-2026-103266 was published on 2026-10-01.

advisories.title: Comment Access-Control Bypass Through Insufficient Input Validation
advisories.desc: Insufficient validation of input used by the comments feature could allow a member to bypass comment-access authorization. Affected ghost versions: >= 5.9.0 and < 6.44.1. Fixed in 6.44.1. CVSS 3.1: 6.5 (Moderate). CWE-943. Published 2026-08-11; CVE-2026-103289 was published on 2026-10-01.

advisories.title: FunctionsBuilder::jsonValue() with PostgresDriver → SQL Injection
advisories.desc: The PostgreSQL jsonValue() implementation could mishandle an untrusted JSON-path argument, resulting in SQL injection. Both cakephp/cakephp and cakephp/database are affected in >= 5.1.0 and < 5.1.10, >= 5.2.0 and < 5.2.15 and >= 5.3.0 and < 5.3.7. Fixed in 5.1.10, 5.2.15 and 5.3.7. CNA CVSS 4.0: 9.2 (Critical); the repository advisory labels the issue High. CWE-89.

advisories.title: SmtpTransport Custom Mail Headers → CRLF Header Injection
advisories.desc: Untrusted custom email header values could introduce additional headers because CRLF characters were not removed. Affected cakephp/cakephp versions: >= 4.5.0 and < 4.5.12; >= 4.6.0 and < 4.6.5; >= 5.0.0 and < 5.1.9; >= 5.2.0 and < 5.2.14; >= 5.3.0 and < 5.3.7. Fixed in 4.5.12, 4.6.5, 5.1.9, 5.2.14 and 5.3.7. CNA CVSS 4.0: 8.2 (High); the repository advisory labels the issue Moderate. CWE-93.

advisories.title: FunctionsBuilder Parameter Handling → SQL Injection in Multiple Methods
advisories.desc: Insufficient validation of type, part and unit arguments in FunctionsBuilder methods including cast(), extract(), datePart() and dateAdd() could permit SQL injection when those arguments include untrusted input. Both cakephp/cakephp and cakephp/database are affected: < 4.5.12; >= 4.6.0 and < 4.6.5; >= 5.0.0 and < 5.1.9; >= 5.2.0 and < 5.2.14; >= 5.3.0 and < 5.3.7. Fixed in 4.5.12, 4.6.5, 5.1.9, 5.2.14 and 5.3.7. The public repository advisory assigns CVE-2026-79752 and High severity, without a numeric CVSS score. CWE-89.

advisories.title: HtmlSanitizer URL Attributes Pass Through BiDi Override Characters → Visual href Spoofing
advisories.desc:
UrlSanitizer::parse() accepted URLs containing Unicode explicit-direction BiDi formatting characters (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) and passed them unchanged into href/src attributes.
When rendered, the override characters reverse the visual ordering of the URL text: the displayed link can differ arbitrarily from the actual destination.
Classic visual-spoofing / phishing primitive against viewers of sanitized content.
Affected symfony/html-sanitizer and symfony/symfony versions: >= 6.1.0 and < 6.4.40; >= 7.0.0 and < 7.4.12; >= 8.0.0 and < 8.0.12. Fixed in 6.4.40, 7.4.12 and 8.0.12.

advisories.title: Mailjet and LOX24 Webhook Parsers Never Verify the Configured Secret → Unauthenticated Webhook Event Injection
advisories.desc:
Both bridges' doParse() methods received the configured webhook secret but never read it; the payload was decoded and returned unconditionally.
Any POST to the webhook endpoint was accepted even when a secret was configured, allowing forged bounce / spam / open / click / delivery events: suppression-list corruption, delivery-metrics fraud, etc.
Affected symfony/mailjet-mailer versions: >= 6.4.0 and < 6.4.40; >= 7.0.0 and < 7.4.12; >= 8.0.0 and < 8.0.12. Fixed in 6.4.40, 7.4.12 and 8.0.12. Affected symfony/lox24-notifier versions: >= 7.1.0 and < 7.4.12; >= 8.0.0 and < 8.0.12. Fixed in 7.4.12 and 8.0.12.

advisories.title: Mailtrap Webhook Parser Never Verifies the X-Mt-Signature HMAC → Unauthenticated Webhook Event Injection
advisories.desc:
The Mailtrap mailer bridge's webhook parser received the configured webhook secret but never read it, ignoring the X-Mt-Signature HMAC header Mailtrap sends with every request.
Any POST to the webhook endpoint was accepted, enabling unauthenticated injection of forged delivery / bounce / open / click / spam events.
Affected symfony/mailtrap-mailer and symfony/symfony versions: >= 7.2.0 and < 7.4.12; >= 8.0.0 and < 8.0.12. Fixed in 7.4.12 and 8.0.12.

advisories.title: JsonPath Evaluates Attacker-Controlled Regular Expressions in match()/search() Without Limits → ReDoS
advisories.desc: JsonPath accepted caller-supplied regular expressions without sufficient restrictions on pattern size or evaluation cost. Expensive expressions could consume excessive CPU and deny service when an application evaluates untrusted JsonPath filters. Affected symfony/json-path and symfony/symfony versions: >= 7.3.0 and < 7.4.12; >= 8.0.0 and < 8.0.12. Fixed in 7.4.12 and 8.0.12. CWE-400 and CWE-1333.

advisories.title: Twilio Webhook Parser Never Verifies the X-Twilio-Signature HMAC → Unauthenticated Webhook Event Injection
advisories.desc:
The Twilio SMS notifier bridge's webhook parser received the configured webhook secret but never read it, ignoring the X-Twilio-Signature HMAC header Twilio sends with every request.
Any POST to the webhook endpoint was accepted, enabling unauthenticated injection of forged delivered / failed / undelivered status events with downstream impact on metrics and automation triggers. Affected Symfony versions are >= 6.4.0 and < 6.4.40, >= 7.0.0 and < 7.4.12 and >= 8.0.0 and < 8.0.12; fixed in 6.4.40, 7.4.12 and 8.0.12.

advisories.title: Symlink Confinement Bypass in resources.Get → Arbitrary File Read
advisories.desc:
A regression introduced in v0.123.0 caused RootMappingFs.statRoot to call Stat (which follows symlinks) instead of Lstat, so a direct resources.Get "somefile" where somefile was a symlink pointing outside the mount would return the target's contents.
A symlink planted inside a theme or local mount (e.g. a locally-vendored theme under themes/) could therefore read arbitrary files reachable to the user running hugo. Themes mounted as Go modules from GitHub have symlinks stripped and are not affected.
Fixed in v0.162.0, which calls LstatIfPossible and rejects symlinked entries.
Affected versions: v0.123.0 through v0.161.1; versions before v0.123.0 are not affected by this regression.

advisories.title: security.http.urls Allow-List Bypass via HTTP Redirects → SSRF
advisories.desc:
resources.GetRemote enforced security.http.urls on the URL it was called with, but until v0.162.0 it did not re-validate intermediate URLs on HTTP 3xx redirects.
An allowed server (or an attacker controlling its DNS or response) could redirect the request to a host the policy was meant to forbid: for example http://localhost/ or an internal IP: and Hugo would fetch from the redirected target, lifting any host-shape restriction the operator had set. Affected v0.91.0 through v0.161.1.
Fixed in v0.162.0, which installs a CheckRedirect that re-runs the policy on every redirect target and caps the chain at 10 hops.

advisories.title: Default CAPTCHA Missing Invalidation → Challenge Replay / CAPTCHA Bypass
advisories.desc:
The inbuilt MyBB Default CAPTCHA did not consistently enforce single-use semantics.
Several endpoints: Contact Us (contact.php), Resend Account Activation, Reset Password and Email User (member.php) and Send to Friend (sendthread.php): never called captcha::invalidate_captcha() after a successful validation, allowing remote attackers to reuse the same valid CAPTCHA response across multiple requests and endpoints until it was invalidated elsewhere or expired. CWE-837 (Improper Enforcement of a Single, Unique Action).
Fixed in MyBB 1.8.40.
Affected versions: MyBB < 1.8.40.

advisories.title: RSCErrorHandler Missing Protocol Validation → Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
advisories.desc: React Router's RSCErrorHandler did not fully validate redirect protocols in the unstable React Server Components (RSC) error-handling path. An attacker-controlled redirect target could result in client-side XSS. This only affects applications using the unstable RSC APIs. Affected react-router versions >= 7.11.0 and < 7.18.0; fixed in 7.18.0. This is a follow-up to GHSA-8646-j5j9-6r62. CVSS 3.1: 6.9 (Moderate).

advisories.title: Improper State Verification in OAuth → Account Takeover
advisories.desc:
Improper state verification in the OAuth implementation allowed an attacker to manipulate the authentication flow and link a victim's account to an attacker-controlled account.
One variant could be exploited even when OAuth was not configured or enabled, resulting in unauthorized account linking and potential account takeover. Affected phpBB 3.3.0 through 3.3.16.
Fixed in phpBB 3.3.17. CNA CVSS 3.0: 8.0 (High), CWE-352.

advisories.title: oEmbed URL Discovery Follows Attacker-Controlled Discovery Links → Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
advisories.desc: Dynamic oEmbed discovery in the Media module could cause Drupal to fetch an untrusted destination, enabling server-side request forgery. Affected Drupal core: < 10.5.12; >= 10.6.0 and < 10.6.11; >= 11.2.0 and < 11.2.14; >= 11.3.0 and < 11.3.12. Unsupported 11.0.x and 11.1.x are also affected. Upgrade to 10.5.12, 10.6.11, 11.2.14 or 11.3.12 or a later supported release. After updating, sites using dynamic URL discovery must explicitly trust discovery hosts through $settings['media_oembed_discovery_trusted_host_patterns'] in settings.php. Drupal rates this Moderately Critical (10/25). Disclosed as SA-CORE-2026-008 on 2026-06-17.

advisories.title: Malformed Image can trick podman run into leaking host environment variables into the container
advisories.desc: Malformed environment entries in an untrusted container image could cause Podman to expose environment variables from the launching host process inside the container. The fix rejects image environment entries that do not use the required key=value format. Affected github.com/containers/podman versions: >= v1.8.1 and <= v5.8.3; fixed in v5.8.4. The advisory separately lists go.podman.io/podman/v6 versions < v6.0.0; fixed in v6.0.0. CVSS 3.1: 7.5 (High).
